svg.title: Random input distributions
svg.desc: The probability distributions that generate arrivals, baskets, picking, payment, walking speed and service times, drawn from the current parameters.

g.text: uniform within small, medium and large
E[S | n] = n s + (a + b + c) / 3

svg.text: Drawn from the current parameters. The service-time band is one standard deviation each side of the mean; the basket bars use the basket-size colours (small, medium, large).
